[b] Sunset | VELSPARIAN EMPIRE | Erene: STARBOUND [/b]

For the past 136 Years, the Empire of Velsparia has been in a state of decline, while the Erenite Federation and the rebound that occurred from its formation did keep the empire stable. It has slowly sunk back into decay, its military has been overexhausted and overextended, its administration has become deeply corrupt, and its economy has been seized by megacorporations. In an attempt to rebuild itself, it has only built a perverted reflection of pre-impact Velsparia. To the average citizen, what has been lost is not only material, but societal and physical, the collapse of family and community structures, and no career advancement, deteriorating conditions, and urban slums. Emperor Francois, however, has eased that pain; for over 30 years, he has guided the empire with a steady hand through these dark times. He has held back the cathartic waves that have begun to strike the country at its core as people everywhere strike out in violence. 

[Spoiler=A most difficult announcement]
A loud ringing noise interrupts Juliette, attempting to catch some sleep after staying up most of the night, she doesn't move at first, then her phones light turns on, forcing her eyes open she look sat the contact name

"Shaun?", she says out loud, she half considers hanging up the call and texting him something like, call me tomorrow, it's late. But, it wasn't like she was going to fall asleep any time soon anyway now, besides Shaun was one of her favorite cousins, so, he gets a pass, this time. She answers after letting it ring for a bit.

"Shaunnnnn. What do you wanttttt it's like...1 am in the morning." She says, annoyingly, slightly muttering curses under her breath

Shaun says, awake as ever, having spent most of the time playing RCSA.

"Sorry, Jules, I know it's late, but I need to talk to you about something..."

"That being Shaun? This isn't about homework, right...because I'm way too tired to do your algebra for you. Again." 

"No Jules! Actually. Im calling about something else this time. Have you seen Uncle Albert around recently? Or at least heard from him? Its been a day and I haven't heard anything at all from him, usually he calls us right?" Juliette pauses. Shaun was Uncle's favorite, and she hadn't gotten a call from him today at all, in fact, she hadn't even really talked to her parents at all today.

"No...why?"

"Well, it's just weird, is all. Not like him to just ghost us for a day. I mean, even when he's busy, he usually still calls, you know? Also, have your parents been acting weird today? Mine have, all shifty, and mother has been in Kingsbury all da-."

Shaun suddenly begins breaking up and slurring his sword. She tries to check the mobile connection on her phone. Maybe another outage? Then, the logo of the dreaded Emergency Alert Broadcast appears, with the loud, dizzing, buzzing. 

"[b]IMPERIAL GOVERNMENT

NATIONAL ANNOUNCEMENT
[/b]"

"This is not a test, please continue to pay attention to the information that will be presented soon. 

This is an emergency announcement. I repeat, this is not a test. An emergency announcement is meant to inform citizens of key events occuring within our borders, even if there is no present or clear threat to our national security or human safety. This activation has been done at the request of the Imperial Senate, and Regency Council."

"...Regency Council?" Juliette thinks for a moment

"The Senate only makes those if..."

"On behalf of the Imperial Government, we come to the people of the empire with a most difficult announcement. His Imperial Majesty, Emperor of Vespurias, Francois II passed away in New Kingsbury Emergency Hospital at 10:30 on Tuesday, the 11th of January, 2167. He leaves us at 57 years old, and in the 32nd year of his reign. He left this realm in the presence of his brothers, sisters, nephew, niece, and mother. Additionally, her Majesty, Queen Amelia, and his royal highness have passed away as well. Crown Prince Jacob is in critical condition. although eailer at around noon, and 5:30 pm respectively. This great, and profound tragedy was caused when the Emperor's plane, which had left Nova Kingsbury on route to the Erenic Council meeting, had a catastrophic, but so far unidentified malfunction that caused total engine failure at 24,000 feet, at which point the aircraft entered an unrecoverable stall, the plane crashed at speed into the crown, killing most people on baord instanlly. 

This is a tragedy for our entire nation. The Imperial Government deeply apologizes and sympathizes with the pain many of you must be feeling right now. Throughout his 32 years of reign he has gained a deep respect not only here, in Velsparia, but abroad as a peacemaker. He has done everything within his power to protect us, his subjects, and has spared no expense in the pursuit of the happiness of his people. He was a monarch of morality, empathy, and of strong will.

We now leave him to rest in the hands of our lord and savior, Jesus Christ. 

With this being said, it goes without saying that our nation is about to go through a period of transition. The office of the President General, which has assumed executive authority under the Emergency Powers Act of 2004, along with the Regency Council assembled by the senate, has made the following declarations:

A 30-day period of mourning will begin today after this announcement airs. This means that all flags on public buildings, federal state will now be lowered to half mast. All public institutions will be closed, including non-essential government offices, national parks, and schools.

Along with this, most news stations will remain off the air to allow for emergency government broadcasts to be more easily transmitted. 

The Regency Council has announced that it is likely that Prince Julian, being the only reasonable candidate at this time, will ascend to the position of emperor. More information will be given in a separate announcement later today. While normally, the direct line of succession would fall to Prince Jacob, his grandmother, who is now his primary guardian has informed the Regency Council that given to the severity of his injuries and what has occurred, it would be unwise to put him on the thrown if he does survive. 

Let us all have a moment of silence for our fallen emperor, the national anthem will begin playing shortly

END OF ALERT."

The national anthem begins to play with a portrait of Emperor Francois, the text scrawl underneath listing 

"A NATION IN MOURNING

Emperor of Velsparia, Emperor Francois II

9th Emperor of the Velsparian Empire

2110-2167"

[/Spoiler]

[Spoiler=First Meeting of the Regency Council]

". . ."

It had been a couple of hours now, the entire nation now knew, it was chaos, the press had confusing and sometimes inaccurate reports airing everywhere, the senate and imperial assembly had broken into absolute chaos, live videos showing fighting and arguments, reports coming that one conservative delegate had thrown a chair at a Whig delegate. The forigen apparatus of the state was in absolute chaos, nobody even knew if Velsparia was in any position to do anything with the current crisis ongoing in the ef. Julian had been about a hundred different places and rooms, and now he was just sitting in a conference room in the royal palace, freshly arriving by helicopter. Smoking a cigar. A grin was growing across his face. How convenient for him that all of this would put him in the perfect position to take power, real power. Surely, the death of his brother was a tragedy. But the opportunity of the moment far outweighed that. The door opened, and members of the regency council shuffled in and took their seats. 

"Gentlemen, before we begin talks of transistion, changing of the crown, and all of that, let us say a prayer for our fallen emperor."

Starts King Benoît, the king of the Kingdom of Maryland, opening his bible

Julian obliges, for a few seconds, the room is dead silent, he reads a bit, and the room joins him in a prayer. He then puts his bible away and begins to speak

"Gentlemen. I think it is no surprise to you that the choice of this meeting will have ripple effects on our entire empire.

The Emperor is the stalwart guardian of the empire and Christian faith, who is chosen must not only embody these ideas but crusade for them. Prince Julian"

"Yes?"

Benoît looks at Julian, a skeptical expression falling across his face

"It is should come as no surprise to you why some think you are...not able to be emperor, that you are...a liability. Why do you think this council should make you emperor?"

"Is...this an interview? It is my divine right. granted by god! You have no right to question me, much less my intentions." Angrily, Julian scowls.

"Julian, you are... technically correct that we legally have no right to stop you, given that Prince Jacob is confirmed comatose, and therefore, the crown falls to you. I was merely trying to gauge your reaction to questioning, and clearly. I was right to do so."

"Why wasn't I told about this development? What more is being kept from me at this moment?"

Benoît continues, "See, your highness. This is what I mean, you're so, if you may pardon me...paranoid. It wories us and the other nobles. Be assued that I am keeping nothing from you, this meeting is simply to inform you that you are the next emperor...however, given your dodging my question..."

"I don't have to put up with this sh*t. That's why. I am perfectly capable of being emperor, and you know it Benoît. How do I know you're not trying to grab the position for yourself huh? Is that why you gathered us here? To make me look like a dam fool?"

Benoît, looks at him, disappointed, and sighs

"I think you're missing the larger point here. See, you just did it again, your highness. Needless speculation. 

Answer my question."

"I already did Benoît. The crown is mine by divine right, I am chosen by god to rule this empire. I am not a liability to you or anyone in this empire!"

Senator Amadou Baudelaire, President pro tempore of the Senate and considered one of the leaders of the Whig Party, finally breaks his silence

"Enough. We have more important things to be doing here than you two going at each other. Benoît, now that it's out of the way that the regency council has chosen him. Isn't there something else you should be telling his majesty? Oh, I don't know. About how he is even supposed to do his job, or the national situation, or anything. Get on with it. I have a senate and assembly to be calming right now."

Benoît stares down Baudelaire before simply nodding his head

"Continuing on then. Director Pelletier, can you please give his majesty the latest situation report?" 

The general nods and begins and slides a holo projector to the center of the table

"Your majesty. I have been given the honor of delivering to your first situation report. 

Firstly, the situation domestically has not calmed down. In fact, with recent news, it is likely to get worse. Im sure you know by now that domestic terrorism like, bombings, shootings, you know the drill. It has gotten worse, esspecially after the news flooding in from the belt. All of this talk of revolution and indepedence has inflamed the "catharsis" movement, as we're calling it. While normally our good friends in United Continental and ConAg would deal with this situation using...uh...does he have clearance for...you know?"

Pelletier says, motioning to the next page, Benoît nods a simple yes

"Clearance for what?" Grabbing his folder and trying to quickly flip to the page Pelletier is on.

"Clearance for...Operation...Panopticon, your highness."

"What's...Operation Panopticon?"

"Operation Panopticon..

.so...your majesty. We have been working with United Continental and Consolidated Agriculture to make...the population more...sugestable, more controllable, you know? And in general, increase national surveillance by alot. At this stage in the operation, United Continental has basically provided us with an automated system that is running 24/7, controlling over 2 billion CTTV and other surveillance devices across the country. While consolidated agriculture has developed several non-detectable drugs that are being put into water and food supplies to calm the nerves of the people. Dooseny also helps with its constant streams of propaganda approved by us.

More recently, we have also been using brain chips, which most of the population has to suppress negative emotions, although that technology is still a bit wonky."

"What the f*ck...is that...is that legal? and wait, you aren't contaminating the water I drink, right?" Julian says, dumbfounded by what was just said to him

"Constituionally? Uh....Debatable, and uh, no, of course not, your majesty. Anyway...while normally, these methods would be enough, it seems that these methods have...stopped being effective. We might need to declare martial law if things continue.  Although for now. I would suggest continuing our current strategies and ramping up surveillance. Once the situation in the belt calms down, we hope that might fix the recent uptick in issues, you know, with the economy going down and all

Now, the situation with the military is. Well, to put it lightly, the military is not able to fight in a forigen conflict right now. Decades of peace have weakened command and strategic thinking. Although we are doing fine equipment-wise, as long as we can keep the appearance of a strong, threatening military up for now. We should be fine until we figure out a way to rehabilitate the command and planning nodes. We hope that the Senate will finally get around to passing that bill to bring in military advisors from the EF to train up a new officer corps. The military, however, does have sigificant experience in fighting and dealing with civil disturbances, so they are still a viable option for keeping the nation under control. "

The briefing goes on for another hour, with Director Pelletier basically giving what amounts to a college lecture about the inner workings of the fragile imperial machine to the new emperor. By the time the meeting ends, Julian is exhausted. His optimism and smug smirk for the title and the crown washed away under the reality of the state of the empire.  
[/Spoiler]
